_meta.title: 100 Europe walk-discovery candidates
_meta.purpose: Editorial research batch for Flaneur. Not imported into data/spots.json.
selection_test: Interesting when encountered from public space on foot
Visually legible without requiring a booking or long detour
Has one sharp historical, architectural or human hook
Avoids generic restaurants, major headline attractions and listicle-only picks
_meta.important: Every candidate must be exact-deduped against data/spots.json, fact-checked with primary/authoritative sources, assigned an existing Ci city slug and ne category, and geocoded inside the city bbox before production import.

entries.s: a façade of stone diamonds
